item.title: Hera ball kicks off Mardi Gras season
item.description: C. Whitten Photography Stacey Landry and Jerry “Tillman” Simmons II were crowned Queen and King Hera IV at the 2025 Krewe of Hera ball in Morgan City. The Tri-City area’s Mardi Gras season gets underway Saturday with the Krewe of Hera ball at Morgan City Auditorium.

item.title: Get It Growing: Staking adds stability to newly planted trees
item.description: LSU AgCenter/Olivia McClure Top photo: Staking can provide stability for newly planted trees. Bottom photo: Damon Abdi, assistant professor of landscape horticulture at the LSU AgCenter Hammond Research Station, demonstrates how to wrap a strap around a tree to connect it to stakes. The cooler months are ideal for planting many tree species in Louisiana.
